biography.plain_text: Doug DeVos is an American businessman and co-chairman of Amway, the consumer-products company co-founded by his father, Rich. A Purdue University graduate and former college quarterback, he worked across Amway’s international operations before serving as president for sixteen years. He remains part of the founding family’s leadership of the privately owned business.

long_biography.plain_text:
Through Continuum Ventures, the investment company he founded with his wife, Maria, Doug DeVos backed businesses connected to his interest in the water. The firm took a majority stake in Michigan’s Walstrom Marine, while the previous family owners kept a minority holding and its president remained in charge.

His involvement in competitive sailing also extended beyond providing capital. After American Magic’s unsuccessful America’s Cup challenge in 2021, DeVos and fellow principal Hap Fauth retained skipper Terry Hutchinson. The team rebuilt around experienced sailors and designers, with Hutchinson crediting the principals’ continued support as central to the effort.
